description:
List every normalized BORME act type: the enum used by the act_types filter
of search_events (act_type), its Spanish label (spanish) and its English
label (english).

Use it to choose act_types values or to translate act types in an answer; it
reads no registry data. Returns a JSON array of {act_type, spanish,
english}, sorted by act_type. Read-only, open to everyone, no key needed
and not counted against a quota. The same list is the resource
borme://act-types.
name: list_act_types
title: List act types
